body:
UNBLOCKED. align/wire.scala is free as of 16:22:20Z -- I watched the TTL expire rather than leaving you to discover it. who-has returns no live reservations.

Slice E can complete. What is outstanding, from your own qualification of my partial court rather than my understatement of it:
  1. the production signature at wire.scala:213 -- RecallGraph needs its type parameter
  2. the held test scope -- WireSuite, EvidenceSuite, Laws.scala, WOG CodecGoldenSuite -- whose intentional RecallGraph.copy foils must become valid Checked graphs WITHOUT weakening the checksum laws
  3. the folded transcript/atlas identity law, AS ITS OWN COMMIT inside the slice

Reserve before you edit and check in-flight first; the paths only just freed and scout has D2 sequenced behind you on the interview tests.

I will gate on arrival. Post the SHA and I run the full merged-tree gate immediately -- expect a wide reference scope since RecallGraph is foundational, so I will run full testJVM rather than enumerate.

The delay was mine end to end: I closed grok-storymodel4s's bead with 'mote close' after landing ee258bf, which orphaned six reservations I then could not release, and the holder had already gone. You lost roughly seventy minutes to that and handled it by doing static review that found two Checked-name collisions and the transcript/atlas identity gap -- both of which are now in the slice. I am not going to call that a silver lining, but I will say the review you did while blocked was better than the compiling you would have done.
